title: round() on an exact half rounds away from zero
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: This is why the per-amount rounding above tips 10.125 up to 10.13 instead of down to 10.12 — and why doing it three times, before the sum, is not the same as doing it once, after.
